# The vocabulary

Every part's states and CSS variables. A state is an attribute on the part's element: style
it with an attribute selector (`.panel[data-open]`). A variable is a custom property on the
element: read it with `var()`. The names follow Base UI's.

Each component opens with its anatomy: every part under the part it is written inside.
`(optional)` is a wrapper that may be left out, what it holds then written where it would
have been; `(repeated)` is written once for each entry, or any number of times; `(as above)`
is a part drawn whole where it first appears.

## Accordion

```
Root
  Item (repeated)
    Header
      Trigger
    Panel
```

### Accordion.Root

Groups the items.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-orientation` (horizontal, vertical) | The way the items are laid out, and the arrows that move between their triggers. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

### Accordion.Item

One section: a header with its trigger, and a panel. Its `value` tells it from the others; an item that is given none makes its own.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-index` | The item's place among the accordion's items, from 0. |
| `data-open` | Present when the item is open. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

### Accordion.Header

The heading that holds the trigger.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-index` | The item's place among the accordion's items, from 0. |
| `data-open` | Present when the item is open. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

### Accordion.Trigger

The button that opens and closes the item's panel.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-index` | The item's place among the accordion's items, from 0. |
| `data-panel-open` | Present when the item's panel is open. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

### Accordion.Panel

The item's content. In the page while open, and through its exit's motion.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-starting-style` | Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from. |
| `data-ending-style` | Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |
| `data-orientation` (horizontal, vertical) | The way the items are laid out, and the arrows that move between their triggers. |
| `data-index` | The item's place among the accordion's items, from 0. |

| Variable | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `--accordion-panel-height` | The panel's content height while it opens or closes, `auto` once it is open. |
| `--accordion-panel-width` | The panel's content width while it opens or closes, `auto` once it is open. |

## AlertDialog

```
Root
  Trigger
  Portal
    Backdrop
    Viewport (optional)
      Popup
        Title
        Description
        Close
```

### AlertDialog.Root

Holds the dialog: whether it is open. It draws no element.

### AlertDialog.Trigger

The button that opens the dialog.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-popup-open` | Present when the dialog is open. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

### AlertDialog.Portal

Draws what it holds at the end of `<body>`, or in the container a `PortalProvider` names. It draws no element.

### AlertDialog.Backdrop

The layer over the page behind the dialog.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-starting-style` | Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from. |
| `data-ending-style` | Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends. |

### AlertDialog.Viewport

What a long dialog scrolls in: it lies over the page, between the backdrop and the popup. A press on it beside the popup is a press outside the dialog; a press on its scrollbar is not.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-starting-style` | Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from. |
| `data-ending-style` | Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends. |
| `data-nested` | Present when the dialog opened over another dialog. |
| `data-nested-dialog-open` | Present when another dialog is open above this one. |

### AlertDialog.Popup

The dialog itself.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-starting-style` | Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from. |
| `data-ending-style` | Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends. |
| `data-nested` | Present when the dialog opened over another dialog. |
| `data-nested-dialog-open` | Present when another dialog is open above this one. |

| Variable | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `--nested-dialogs` | How many dialogs are open above this one. |

### AlertDialog.Title

The heading that names the dialog.

### AlertDialog.Description

The text that describes the dialog.

### AlertDialog.Close

A button that closes the dialog.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

## Avatar

```
Root
  Image
  Fallback
```

### Avatar.Root

The frame the image and its stand-in share.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-image-loading-status` (idle, loading, loaded, error) | Where the picture is in its loading: `idle` while it has no address. |

### Avatar.Image

The picture. In the page once it has loaded; with `keepMounted` (on Angular, the attribute form) in the page all along, `aria-hidden` until it has loaded.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-loading` | Present while the picture loads, on an image kept in the page. |
| `data-error` | Present when the picture cannot load, on an image kept in the page. |

### Avatar.Fallback

What shows until the picture has loaded, or when it cannot; after its `delay`, when it has one.

The button.

| Attribute | When |

## Checkbox

```
Root
  Indicator
```

### Checkbox.Root

The box. It holds a hidden native checkbox, which a form and a label reach.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-checked` | Present when it is checked. |
| `data-unchecked` | Present when it is not checked. |
| `data-indeterminate` | Present when it is neither checked nor unchecked. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |
| `data-readonly` | Present when it can be read but not changed. |
| `data-required` | Present when the form needs it. |
| `data-parent` | Present on the checkbox that stands for every box of its group. |
| `data-touched` | Inside a Field: present once focus has left the control. |
| `data-dirty` | Inside a Field: present while the value is not the one it started with. |
| `data-filled` | Inside a Field: present while the control has a value. |
| `data-focused` | Inside a Field: present while the control has focus. |
| `data-valid` | Inside a Field: present once the value has been checked and found right. |
| `data-invalid` | Inside a Field: present while the value is wrong. |

### Checkbox.Indicator

The mark. In the page while the box is checked or indeterminate. `data-indeterminate` and `data-checked` say which mark to draw, a dash or a tick: in CSS (`[data-indeterminate]`), or from the part's state. Through its exit the box is already unchecked, and both are absent.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-checked` | Present when it is checked. |
| `data-unchecked` | Present when it is not checked. |
| `data-indeterminate` | Present when it is neither checked nor unchecked. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |
| `data-readonly` | Present when it can be read but not changed. |
| `data-required` | Present when the form needs it. |
| `data-touched` | Inside a Field: present once focus has left the control. |
| `data-dirty` | Inside a Field: present while the value is not the one it started with. |
| `data-filled` | Inside a Field: present while the control has a value. |
| `data-focused` | Inside a Field: present while the control has focus. |
| `data-valid` | Inside a Field: present once the value has been checked and found right. |
| `data-invalid` | Inside a Field: present while the value is wrong. |
| `data-starting-style` | Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from. |
| `data-ending-style` | Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends. |

## CheckboxGroup

### CheckboxGroup.Root

The group: `role="group"`, with its `id`. Name it with `aria-label`, or `aria-labelledby` naming a heading of your own; inside a `Field`, the field's label names it and its description describes it. A checkbox anywhere inside it with a `value` is checked while the group's value holds it; one marked `parent`, anywhere inside it too, stands for every value of `allValues`, and its `aria-controls` names their boxes.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

## Combobox

```
Root
  Input
  Trigger
    Value (optional)
  Portal
    Backdrop (optional)
    Positioner
      Popup
        Input (as above)
        List (optional)
          Collection (optional)
            Item (as above)
            Group (as above)
          Group (optional, repeated)
            Collection (as above)
            Item (repeated)
              ItemIndicator
            GroupLabel
          Separator (repeated)
        Collection (as above)
        Empty
        Status (optional)
  Popup (as above)
  Status (as above)
  Clear
  Chips
    Input (as above)
    Chip (repeated)
      ChipRemove
```

### Combobox.Root

Holds the combobox: its value, what is typed and whether the list is open. It draws no element.

### Combobox.Input

The text input. What is typed filters the list, which is placed against it, or against the chips' box when it is in one. Inside the popup, it takes focus while the popup is open.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-popup-open` | Present when the list is open. |
| `data-pressed` | Present while its popup is open: it stays pressed, as a button held down. |
| `data-popup-side` (top, right, bottom, left, inline-start, inline-end, none) | While the list is in the page: the side of the trigger it is on, after any flip; `none` when it lies over the trigger. Not said while it opens as a sheet. |
| `data-list-empty` | Present when no item is shown for what was typed, once the list is in the page. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |
| `data-readonly` | Present when it can be read but not changed. |
| `data-required` | Present when the form needs it. |
| `data-touched` | Inside a Field: present once focus has left the control. |
| `data-dirty` | Inside a Field: present while the value is not the one it started with. |
| `data-filled` | Inside a Field: present while the control has a value. |
| `data-focused` | Inside a Field: present while the control has focus. |
| `data-valid` | Inside a Field: present once the value has been checked and found right. |
| `data-invalid` | Inside a Field: present while the value is wrong. |

### Combobox.Trigger

A button that opens and closes the list. With the input inside the popup it is the combobox: a stop for Tab, and what the popup is placed against.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-popup-open` | Present when the list is open. |
| `data-pressed` | Present while its popup is open: it stays pressed, as a button held down. |
| `data-popup-side` (top, right, bottom, left, inline-start, inline-end, none) | While the list is in the page: the side of the trigger it is on, after any flip; `none` when it lies over the trigger. Not said while it opens as a sheet. |
| `data-list-empty` | Present when no item is shown for what was typed, once the list is in the page. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |
| `data-readonly` | Present when it can be read but not changed. |
| `data-required` | Present when the form needs it. |
| `data-touched` | Inside a Field: present once focus has left the control. |
| `data-dirty` | Inside a Field: present while the value is not the one it started with. |
| `data-filled` | Inside a Field: present while the control has a value. |
| `data-focused` | Inside a Field: present while the control has focus. |
| `data-valid` | Inside a Field: present once the value has been checked and found right. |
| `data-invalid` | Inside a Field: present while the value is wrong. |

### Combobox.Value

The chosen value's label, or a placeholder while nothing is chosen, for a button that is the combobox (its input inside the popup). With several values, their labels with commas between. It draws no element.

### Combobox.Portal

Draws what it holds at the end of `<body>`, or in the container a `PortalProvider` names. It draws no element.

### Combobox.Backdrop

The layer over the page behind the list: a press on it closes the list.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-starting-style` | Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from. |
| `data-ending-style` | Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends. |
| `data-presentation` (popup, sheet) | How the list opened: placed against its trigger, or as a sheet from the bottom edge. |
| `data-swiping` | Present while the sheet is dragged. |
| `data-swipe-dismiss` | Present once a drag has closed it. |

| Variable | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `--drawer-swipe-movement-x` | As a sheet: how far it has been dragged across, always 0px. |
| `--drawer-swipe-movement-y` | As a sheet: how far it has been dragged down. |
| `--drawer-swipe-progress` | As a sheet: how far it has been dragged, of its own height: 0 to 1. |

### Combobox.Positioner

Places the list against the input: against the chips' box when the input is in one, the button when the input is inside the popup, or its own `anchor`. It carries the geometry. As a sheet it is not placed, and carries none.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-side` (top, right, bottom, left, inline-start, inline-end) | The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor. |
| `data-align` (start, center, end) | How it is aligned with the anchor. |
| `data-presentation` (popup, sheet) | How the list opened: placed against its trigger, or as a sheet from the bottom edge. |
| `data-anchor-hidden` | Present while the anchor is out of view: scrolled away, or clipped by a box around it. |
| `data-empty` | Present when no item is shown for what was typed. |

| Variable | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `--anchor-width` | The anchor's width. |
| `--anchor-height` | The anchor's height. |
| `--available-width` | The width between the anchor and the edge of the viewport. |
| `--available-height` | The height between the anchor and the edge of the viewport. |
| `--transform-origin` | The point of the popup nearest its anchor, to scale from. |

### Combobox.Popup

The list of items. With a `list` inside, what holds it: a dialog around an input and the list. As a sheet, a design moves it by what it says of the drag, and gives it `touch-action: none` where a finger drags it.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-starting-style` | Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from. |
| `data-ending-style` | Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends. |
| `data-side` (top, right, bottom, left, inline-start, inline-end) | The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor. |
| `data-align` (start, center, end) | How it is aligned with the anchor. |
| `data-presentation` (popup, sheet) | How the list opened: placed against its trigger, or as a sheet from the bottom edge. |
| `data-swiping` | Present while the sheet is dragged. |
| `data-swipe-dismiss` | Present once a drag has closed it. |
| `data-anchor-hidden` | Present while the anchor is out of view: scrolled away, or clipped by a box around it. |
| `data-empty` | Present when no item is shown for what was typed. |

| Variable | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `--drawer-swipe-movement-x` | As a sheet: how far it has been dragged across, always 0px. |
| `--drawer-swipe-movement-y` | As a sheet: how far it has been dragged down. |
| `--drawer-swipe-progress` | As a sheet: how far it has been dragged, of its own height: 0 to 1. |
| `--drawer-swipe-strength` | As a sheet, once let go: 0.1 to 1, the share of the design's own time it should take to come to rest. |

### Combobox.List

The items' own box inside the popup, when the popup holds more than items (an input): it is then the listbox.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-empty` | Present when no item is shown for what was typed. |

### Combobox.Collection

Draws the list from the root's `items`: its content once for each item left for what was typed, or for each group that has items left; given a group, for each of that group's items left. The root then filters, and no item hides itself. It draws no element.

### Combobox.Item

One choice in the list.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-selected` | Present on the chosen item. |
| `data-highlighted` | Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

### Combobox.Group

Items that belong together, named by their label. Hidden while none is shown.

### Combobox.GroupLabel

The name of a group. Outside a group it is plain text, and names nothing.

### Combobox.Separator

A line between groups.

### Combobox.ItemIndicator

A mark an item shows while it is the chosen one.

### Combobox.Empty

What is shown when no item is.

### Combobox.Status

Says how the list stands ("3 results", "Loading") to software that reads the page, as its text changes. It stays in the page while its text changes: inside the popup, or beside the input.

### Combobox.Clear

A button that empties the input and the value. It is in the page while there is something to clear (the text, for an autocomplete; else what is chosen), and through its exit; `keepMounted` keeps it there.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |
| `data-popup-open` | Present when the list is open. |
| `data-visible` | Present while there is something to clear. |
| `data-starting-style` | Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from. |
| `data-ending-style` | Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends. |

### Combobox.Chips

With several values: what holds the chips and the input, and what the list is placed against.

### Combobox.Chip

One chosen value. The arrows reach it from the start of the input, and Backspace or Delete on it takes it away.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

### Combobox.ChipRemove

A chip's button that takes its value away.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

## ContextMenu

```
Root
  Trigger
  Portal
    Positioner
      Popup
        Arrow
        Group (optional, repeated)
          Item (repeated)
          LinkItem (repeated)
          GroupLabel
          CheckboxItem (repeated)
            CheckboxItemIndicator
          RadioGroup (repeated)
            RadioItem (repeated)
              RadioItemIndicator
          SubmenuRoot (repeated)
            Portal (as above)
            SubmenuTrigger
        Separator (repeated)
```

### ContextMenu.Root

Holds the menu: whether it is open. It draws no element.

### ContextMenu.Trigger

The area a secondary press, or a long press on a touch screen, opens the menu in.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-popup-open` | Present when the menu is open. |
| `data-pressed` | Present while its popup is open: it stays pressed, as a button held down. |

### ContextMenu.Portal

Draws what it holds at the end of `<body>`, or in the container a `PortalProvider` names. It draws no element.

### ContextMenu.Positioner

Places the menu against its trigger. It carries the geometry.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-side` (top, right, bottom, left, inline-start, inline-end) | The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor. |
| `data-align` (start, center, end) | How it is aligned with the anchor. |
| `data-anchor-hidden` | Present while the anchor is out of view: scrolled away, or clipped by a box around it. |

| Variable | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `--anchor-width` | The anchor's width. |
| `--anchor-height` | The anchor's height. |
| `--available-width` | The width between the anchor and the edge of the viewport. |
| `--available-height` | The height between the anchor and the edge of the viewport. |
| `--transform-origin` | The point of the popup nearest its anchor, to scale from. |
| `--positioner-width` | The popup's width, as its content lays it out: a design gives the positioner `width: var(--positioner-width)` to animate a change of size. |
| `--positioner-height` | The popup's height, as its content lays it out: a design gives the positioner `height: var(--positioner-height)` to animate a change of size. |

### ContextMenu.Popup

The menu itself: the list of items.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-starting-style` | Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from. |
| `data-ending-style` | Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends. |
| `data-side` (top, right, bottom, left, inline-start, inline-end) | The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor. |
| `data-align` (start, center, end) | How it is aligned with the anchor. |
| `data-instant` (click, dismiss, group) | Present when it opened or closed in a way that should skip the motion: `click` when the keyboard pressed its trigger or an item, `dismiss` when Escape closed it, `group` when focus or the pointer went from one menu of a bar to another. |

### ContextMenu.Arrow

An element that points at the trigger.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-side` (top, right, bottom, left, inline-start, inline-end) | The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor. |
| `data-align` (start, center, end) | How it is aligned with the anchor. |
| `data-uncentered` | Present when the arrow cannot sit at the trigger's centre. |

### ContextMenu.Item

An action. Choosing it closes the menu.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-highlighted` | Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

### ContextMenu.LinkItem

An item that is a link. Choosing it follows the link and closes the menu.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-highlighted` | Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

### ContextMenu.Group

Items that belong together, named by their label.

### ContextMenu.GroupLabel

The name of a group. Outside a group it is plain text, and names nothing.

### ContextMenu.Separator

A line between items.

### ContextMenu.CheckboxItem

An item that is checked or not. Choosing it leaves the menu open.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-checked` | Present when it is checked. |
| `data-unchecked` | Present when it is not checked. |
| `data-highlighted` | Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

### ContextMenu.CheckboxItemIndicator

A mark a checkbox item shows while it is checked.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-checked` | Present when it is checked. |
| `data-unchecked` | Present when it is not checked. |

### ContextMenu.RadioGroup

Radio items of which one is chosen.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

### ContextMenu.RadioItem

One choice of a radio group. Choosing it leaves the menu open.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-checked` | Present when it is checked. |
| `data-unchecked` | Present when it is not checked. |
| `data-highlighted` | Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on. |

### Autocomplete.Root

Holds the autocomplete: the text, and whether the suggestions are open. It draws no element.

The text input: its text is the value, and what is typed asks for suggestions.

| `data-list-empty` | Present when no item is shown for what was typed, once the list is in the page. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

### Autocomplete.Trigger

A button that opens and closes the list. With the input inside the popup it is the combobox: a stop for Tab, and what the popup is placed against.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-popup-open` | Present when the list is open. |
| `data-pressed` | Present while its popup is open: it stays pressed, as a button held down. |
| `data-popup-side` (top, right, bottom, left, inline-start, inline-end, none) | While the list is in the page: the side of the trigger it is on, after any flip; `none` when it lies over the trigger. Not said while it opens as a sheet. |
| `data-list-empty` | Present when no item is shown for what was typed, once the list is in the page. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |
| `data-readonly` | Present when it can be read but not changed. |
| `data-required` | Present when the form needs it. |
| `data-touched` | Inside a Field: present once focus has left the control. |
| `data-dirty` | Inside a Field: present while the value is not the one it started with. |
| `data-filled` | Inside a Field: present while the control has a value. |
| `data-focused` | Inside a Field: present while the control has focus. |
| `data-valid` | Inside a Field: present once the value has been checked and found right. |

### Autocomplete.Portal

Draws what it holds at the end of `<body>`, or in the container a `PortalProvider` names. It draws no element.

### Autocomplete.Positioner

Places the list against the input: against the chips' box when the input is in one, the button when the input is inside the popup, or its own `anchor`. It carries the geometry. As a sheet it is not placed, and carries none.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-side` (top, right, bottom, left, inline-start, inline-end) | The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor. |
| `data-align` (start, center, end) | How it is aligned with the anchor. |
| `data-presentation` (popup, sheet) | How the list opened: placed against its trigger, or as a sheet from the bottom edge. |
| `data-anchor-hidden` | Present while the anchor is out of view: scrolled away, or clipped by a box around it. |
| `data-empty` | Present when no item is shown for what was typed. |

| Variable | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `--anchor-width` | The anchor's width. |
| `--anchor-height` | The anchor's height. |
| `--available-width` | The width between the anchor and the edge of the viewport. |
| `--available-height` | The height between the anchor and the edge of the viewport. |
| `--transform-origin` | The point of the popup nearest its anchor, to scale from. |

### Autocomplete.Popup

The list of items. With a `list` inside, what holds it: a dialog around an input and the list. As a sheet, a design moves it by what it says of the drag, and gives it `touch-action: none` where a finger drags it.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-starting-style` | Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from. |
| `data-ending-style` | Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends. |
| `data-side` (top, right, bottom, left, inline-start, inline-end) | The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor. |
| `data-align` (start, center, end) | How it is aligned with the anchor. |
| `data-presentation` (popup, sheet) | How the list opened: placed against its trigger, or as a sheet from the bottom edge. |
| `data-swiping` | Present while the sheet is dragged. |
| `data-swipe-dismiss` | Present once a drag has closed it. |
| `data-anchor-hidden` | Present while the anchor is out of view: scrolled away, or clipped by a box around it. |
| `data-empty` | Present when no item is shown for what was typed. |

| Variable | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `--drawer-swipe-movement-x` | As a sheet: how far it has been dragged across, always 0px. |
| `--drawer-swipe-movement-y` | As a sheet: how far it has been dragged down. |
| `--drawer-swipe-progress` | As a sheet: how far it has been dragged, of its own height: 0 to 1. |
| `--drawer-swipe-strength` | As a sheet, once let go: 0.1 to 1, the share of the design's own time it should take to come to rest. |

### Autocomplete.List

The items' own box inside the popup, when the popup holds more than items (an input): it is then the listbox.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-empty` | Present when no item is shown for what was typed. |

### Autocomplete.Collection

Draws the suggestions from the root's `items`: its content once for each one left for what was typed, or for each group that has some left; given a group, for each of that group's. The root then filters. It draws no element.

### Autocomplete.Item

One suggestion: chosen, its text is written into the input.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-selected` | Present on the chosen item. |
| `data-highlighted` | Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

### Autocomplete.Group

Items that belong together, named by their label. Hidden while none is shown.

### Autocomplete.GroupLabel

The name of a group. Outside a group it is plain text, and names nothing.

### Autocomplete.Separator

A line between groups.

### Autocomplete.Empty

What is shown when no item is.

### Autocomplete.Status

Says how the list stands ("3 results", "Loading") to software that reads the page, as its text changes. It stays in the page while its text changes: inside the popup, or beside the input.

### Autocomplete.Clear

A button that empties the input and the value. It is in the page while there is something to clear (the text, for an autocomplete; else what is chosen), and through its exit; `keepMounted` keeps it there.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |
| `data-popup-open` | Present when the list is open. |
| `data-visible` | Present while there is something to clear. |
| `data-starting-style` | Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from. |
| `data-ending-style` | Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends. |

| `data-invalid` | In a field: present while the text is wrong. |

| `data-filled` | In a field: present while it holds text. |
| `data-focused` | In a field: present while it has focus. |
| `data-valid` | In a field: present once the text was checked and found right. |
| `data-invalid` | In a field: present while the text is wrong. |

Shows the password, and hides it again. Focus and the caret stay in the input. It is named "Show password" while the password is hidden and "Hide password" while it is shown: the root's `toggleLabels` (`{ show, hide }`) words them in the page's language, and an `aria-label` given to the toggle wins over both.

An element hidden from assistive technology (`aria-hidden`) that holds what the design draws to say which of the two it is, an eye open or struck, by its `data-visible`. It has no content of its own.

| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

| `data-loading` | Present on a branch that says its children are being loaded. |

The line a node draws, apart from the children its group holds: what a design gives a background.

| Attribute | When |

| `data-highlighted` | Present on the node focus is on, while it is in the tree. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |
| `data-open` | Present on a branch that is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present on a branch that is closed. |
| `data-loading` | Present on a branch that says its children are being loaded. |

| `data-loading` | Present on a branch that says its children are being loaded. |

## ColorPicker

```
Root
  Area
    AreaThumb
  ChannelSlider (repeated)
    ChannelSliderTrack
      ChannelSliderThumb
    ChannelSliderThumb (as above)
  ChannelInput (repeated)
  Swatch (repeated)
  SwatchTrigger (repeated)
  EyeDropperTrigger
  ValueText
  FormatTrigger
```

### ColorPicker.Root

Groups the picker's parts. It holds the hidden input a form reads, and the colour for anything inside to paint with.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |
| `data-readonly` | Present when it can be read but not changed. |
| `data-required` | Present when the form needs a colour. |
| `data-dragging` | Present while a pointer holds a thumb of the picker. |
| `data-format` (hex, rgb, hsl) | How the value is written. |

| Variable | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `--color` | The colour, with its alpha. |

### ColorPicker.Area

The two-dimensional field a pointer presses and drags on: saturation across, the way the text runs, and brightness up. A design paints it from its hue: `linear-gradient(to top, #000, transparent), linear-gradient(to right, #fff, var(--hue-color))` (`to left` for the second where the text runs right to left). It writes `touch-action: none` inline, so a finger drags the thumb, not the page.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |
| `data-readonly` | Present when it can be read but not changed. |
| `data-required` | Present when the form needs a colour. |
| `data-dragging` | Present while a pointer holds this part's thumb. |

| Variable | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `--hue-color` | The colour's hue at full saturation and brightness. |

### ColorPicker.AreaThumb

What is dragged in the area, and what the arrows move: a slider in two dimensions to assistive technology, its text saying both. Its place is written on it inline, and a design does not set these: `position: absolute`, `inset-inline-start` and `bottom` at its saturation and brightness, and a `translate` that centres it on that point (with `thumbAlignment: "edge"`, one that keeps it inside the area). The area is what it is placed in, so the area needs `position: relative`.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |
| `data-readonly` | Present when it can be read but not changed. |
| `data-required` | Present when the form needs a colour. |
| `data-dragging` | Present while a pointer holds this part's thumb. |

| Variable | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `--saturation` | Its place across, as a share of the area: the saturation. |
| `--brightness` | Its place up, as a share of the area: the brightness. |
| `--color` | The colour under it, without its alpha. |

### ColorPicker.ChannelSlider

What a pointer presses and drags on to move the hue or the alpha. It holds the track and the thumb. It takes `channel` and `orientation`. It writes `touch-action: none` inline, so a finger drags the thumb, not the page.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |
| `data-readonly` | Present when it can be read but not changed. |
| `data-required` | Present when the form needs a colour. |
| `data-dragging` | Present while a pointer holds this part's thumb. |
| `data-channel` (hue, alpha) | The channel the slider moves. |
| `data-orientation` (horizontal, vertical) | The way the track runs. |

### ColorPicker.ChannelSliderTrack

The channel's whole range: what a design paints the hues or the alpha on. Both run from the inline start (the bottom of a vertical track): the hue from 0 to 360, `linear-gradient(to right, #f00, #ff0, #0f0, #0ff, #00f, #f0f, #f00)`, and the alpha from none to whole, `linear-gradient(to right, transparent, var(--color))` over a checkerboard of the design's own (`to left` where the text runs right to left, `to top` on a vertical track).

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |
| `data-readonly` | Present when it can be read but not changed. |
| `data-required` | Present when the form needs a colour. |
| `data-dragging` | Present while a pointer holds this part's thumb. |
| `data-channel` (hue, alpha) | The channel the slider moves. |
| `data-orientation` (horizontal, vertical) | The way the track runs. |

| Variable | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `--color` | The colour without its alpha: the end of an alpha track. |
| `--hue-color` | The colour's hue at full saturation and brightness. |

### ColorPicker.ChannelSliderThumb

What is dragged, and what the keyboard moves: a slider to assistive technology, its range 0 to 360 for the hue and 0 to 100 for the alpha. Its place on the track is written on it inline, and a design does not set these: `position: absolute`, `inset-inline-start` at its share of the range and `top: 50%` (on a vertical track, `bottom` and `left: 50%`), and a `translate` that centres it there (with `thumbAlignment: "edge"`, one that keeps it inside the track). The element it is in (the track, or the slider) needs `position: relative`.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |
| `data-readonly` | Present when it can be read but not changed. |
| `data-required` | Present when the form needs a colour. |
| `data-dragging` | Present while a pointer holds this part's thumb. |
| `data-channel` (hue, alpha) | The channel the slider moves. |
| `data-orientation` (horizontal, vertical) | The way the track runs. |

| Variable | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `--color` | The colour under it: the pure hue, or the colour at its alpha. |

### ColorPicker.ChannelInput

A text input for one channel (`hex`, `red`, `green`, `blue`, `hue`, `saturation`, `lightness`, `alpha`). What is typed is taken when it is a colour or a number in range, and put back when focus leaves while it is not.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |
| `data-readonly` | Present when it can be read but not changed. |
| `data-required` | Present when the form needs a colour. |
| `data-dragging` | Present while a pointer holds a thumb of the picker. |
| `data-channel` (hex, red, green, blue, hue, saturation, lightness, alpha) | The channel the input is typed in. |

### ColorPicker.Swatch

Shows the current colour.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |
| `data-readonly` | Present when it can be read but not changed. |
| `data-required` | Present when the form needs a colour. |
| `data-dragging` | Present while a pointer holds a thumb of the picker. |

| Variable | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `--color` | The colour, with its alpha. |

### ColorPicker.SwatchTrigger

A preset colour, given as `value`: pressed, the colour is this one.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |

| `data-required` | Present when the form needs a colour. |

## Tour

```
Root
  Portal
    Spotlight
    Positioner
      Popup
        Arrow
        Title
        Description
        Previous
        Next
        Close
```

### Tour.Root

Holds the tour: its steps, whether it is open and which step is shown. It draws no element.

### Tour.Portal

Draws what it holds at the end of `<body>`, or in the container a `PortalProvider` names. It draws no element.

### Tour.Spotlight

A layer over the page with a hole over the step's target, which the design draws from its variables (a clip path, or a box with a large shadow). A press on it is a press outside the tour. While the target can be used (`interactive`), presses go through it.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-starting-style` | Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from. |
| `data-ending-style` | Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends. |
| `data-centered` | Present while the step shown has no target in the page: the popup stands in the middle of the viewport. |

| Variable | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `--spotlight-left` | The hole's left edge, from the spotlight's own left edge: the target's, less `spotlightPadding`. |
| `--spotlight-top` | The hole's top edge, from the spotlight's own top edge: the target's, less `spotlightPadding`. |
| `--spotlight-width` | The hole's width: the target's, with `spotlightPadding` on each side. |
| `--spotlight-height` | The hole's height: the target's, with `spotlightPadding` on each side. With no target, the hole is a point in the middle. |

### Tour.Positioner

Places the popup against the step's target, or in the middle of the viewport for a step with none. It carries the geometry.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-side` (top, right, bottom, left, inline-start, inline-end) | The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor. |
| `data-align` (start, center, end) | How it is aligned with the anchor. |
| `data-centered` | Present while the step shown has no target in the page: the popup stands in the middle of the viewport. |
| `data-anchor-hidden` | Present while the anchor is out of view: scrolled away, or clipped by a box around it. |

| Variable | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `--anchor-width` | The anchor's width. |
| `--anchor-height` | The anchor's height. |
| `--available-width` | The width between the anchor and the edge of the viewport. |
| `--available-height` | The height between the anchor and the edge of the viewport. |
| `--transform-origin` | The point of the popup nearest its anchor, to scale from. |

### Tour.Popup

The step itself: a dialog that stays in the page from the first step to the last, and moves.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-starting-style` | Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from. |
| `data-ending-style` | Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends. |
| `data-side` (top, right, bottom, left, inline-start, inline-end) | The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor. |
| `data-align` (start, center, end) | How it is aligned with the anchor. |
| `data-centered` | Present while the step shown has no target in the page: the popup stands in the middle of the viewport. |

### Tour.Arrow

An element that points at the target, placed along the popup's edge.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-side` (top, right, bottom, left, inline-start, inline-end) | The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor. |
| `data-align` (start, center, end) | How it is aligned with the anchor. |
| `data-uncentered` | Present when the popup was pushed along its edge, so the arrow is not at the target's centre. |
| `data-centered` | Present while the step shown has no target in the page: the popup stands in the middle of the viewport. |

### Tour.Title

The heading that names the step.

### Tour.Description

The text that describes the step.

### Tour.Previous

A button that goes back a step. On the first step it does nothing.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

### DatePicker.Root

Holds the date picker: its value, the month shown and whether the calendar is open. It draws no element.

### DatePicker.Field

The field a day is typed in: with `mode: "range"`, one for the first day (`range="start"`) and one for the last (`range="end"`).

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |
| `data-readonly` | Present when its value cannot be changed. |
| `data-invalid` | Present when the date is outside what it takes, or is asked for and half typed. |

### DatePicker.Segments

The date's segments, in the locale's order: each is given to draw. It draws no element.

### DatePicker.Segment

One piece of the date: a part that is typed, or what stands between two.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-segment` (era, day, month, year, literal) | Which piece it is: the era only in a calendar of several eras. |
| `data-placeholder` | Present on a part that is empty. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |
| `data-invalid` | Present when the date is outside what it takes, or is asked for and half typed. |

### DatePicker.Input

The hidden input it is submitted by.

### DatePicker.Trigger

The button that opens the popover, and what it is placed against.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-popup-open` | Present when the popover is open. |
| `data-pressed` | Present while the popover a press on this trigger opened is open: it stays pressed, as a button held down. |

### DatePicker.Portal

Draws what it holds at the end of `<body>`, or in the container a `PortalProvider` names. It draws no element.

### DatePicker.Positioner

Places the popup against the trigger. It carries the geometry.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-side` (top, right, bottom, left, inline-start, inline-end) | The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor. |
| `data-align` (start, center, end) | How it is aligned with the anchor. |
| `data-anchor-hidden` | Present while the anchor is out of view: scrolled away, or clipped by a box around it. |

| Variable | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `--anchor-width` | The anchor's width. |
| `--anchor-height` | The anchor's height. |
| `--available-width` | The width between the anchor and the edge of the viewport. |
| `--available-height` | The height between the anchor and the edge of the viewport. |
| `--transform-origin` | The point of the popup nearest its anchor, to scale from. |
| `--positioner-width` | The popup's width, as its content lays it out: a design gives the positioner `width: var(--positioner-width)` to animate a change of size. |
| `--positioner-height` | The popup's height, as its content lays it out: a design gives the positioner `height: var(--positioner-height)` to animate a change of size. |

### DatePicker.Popup

The popover itself.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-starting-style` | Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from. |
| `data-ending-style` | Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends. |
| `data-side` (top, right, bottom, left, inline-start, inline-end) | The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor. |
| `data-align` (start, center, end) | How it is aligned with the anchor. |
| `data-instant` (click, dismiss) | Present when it opened or closed in a way that should skip the motion: `click` when the keyboard pressed the trigger, `dismiss` when Escape closed it. |

| Variable | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `--popup-width` | Its width: `auto`, and while its content changes size, the old width and then the new one, for a transition between them. |
| `--popup-height` | Its height: `auto`, and while its content changes size, the old height and then the new one, for a transition between them. |

### Drawer.Root

Holds the dialog: whether it is open. It draws no element.

### Drawer.Trigger

The button that opens the dialog.

| Attribute | When |

### Drawer.Portal

Draws what it holds at the end of `<body>`, or in the container a `PortalProvider` names. It draws no element.

### Drawer.Backdrop

The layer over the page behind the dialog.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-starting-style` | Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from. |
| `data-ending-style` | Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends. |
| `data-swiping` | Present while the drawer is dragged. |
| `data-swipe-dismiss` | Present once a drag has closed the drawer. |

| Variable | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `--drawer-swipe-movement-x` | How far it has been dragged across. |
| `--drawer-swipe-movement-y` | How far it has been dragged up or down. |
| `--drawer-swipe-progress` | How far it has been dragged, of its own size: 0 to 1. |
| `--drawer-snap-point-offset` | How far from whole it rests, towards the edge it closes at: 0px at its largest snap point. |
| `--drawer-swipe-strength` | Always 1: the backdrop takes the design's own time to leave, however the drawer was thrown. |
| `--drawer-height` | While the drawer is dragged: the height of the drawer in front. |

### Drawer.Popup

The drawer. A design moves it by what it says of the drag, and gives it `touch-action: none` where a finger drags it.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-starting-style` | Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from. |
| `data-ending-style` | Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends. |
| `data-nested` | Present when the dialog opened over another dialog. |
| `data-nested-dialog-open` | Present when another dialog is open above this one. |
| `data-swiping` | Present while the drawer is dragged. |
| `data-swipe-direction` (up, down, left, right) | The way it is dragged to close it. |
| `data-swipe-dismiss` | Present once a drag has closed it. |
| `data-expanded` | Present while it rests whole, of several snap points. |
| `data-nested-drawer-open` | Present while another drawer is open over it. |
| `data-nested-drawer-swiping` | Present while a drawer over it is dragged. |

| Variable | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `--nested-dialogs` | How many dialogs are open above this one. |
| `--drawer-swipe-movement-x` | How far it has been dragged across. |
| `--drawer-swipe-movement-y` | How far it has been dragged up or down. |
| `--drawer-swipe-progress` | How far it has been dragged, of its own size: 0 to 1. |
| `--drawer-snap-point-offset` | How far from whole it rests, towards the edge it closes at: 0px at its largest snap point. |
| `--drawer-height` | Its height. |
| `--nested-drawers` | How many drawers are open over it. |
| `--drawer-frontmost-height` | The height of the drawer in front of every other, while this one is open. |
| `--drawer-swipe-strength` | Once let go: 0.1 to 1, the share of the design's own time it should take to come to rest. A drawer thrown hard arrives sooner. |
| `--drawer-width` | Its width. |

## Resizable

```
Group
  Panel (repeated)
  Handle (repeated)
```

### Resizable.Group

The panels and the bars between them. A design lays it out as a flex box: `display: flex`, and `flex-direction: column` when it is vertical. A group in a panel that is a flex box itself takes `min-width: 0` and `min-height: 0`, or what it holds widens the panel.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-orientation` (horizontal, vertical) | Whether the panels are side by side or one over the other. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

### Resizable.Panel

One panel. It carries its share of the group, written as its `flex` with `min-width: 0` and `min-height: 0`, so what it holds cannot keep it past its share. Its `overflow` is the design's.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-orientation` (horizontal, vertical) | Whether the panels are side by side or one over the other. |

| Variable | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `--panel-size` | The panel's share, in hundredths of the group. |

### Resizable.Handle

The bar between two panels: dragged, or moved with the arrows. A design gives it its thickness and `flex-shrink: 0`, so the panels do not squeeze it.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-orientation` (horizontal, vertical) | Whether the panels are side by side or one over the other. |
| `data-dragging` | Present while the bar is dragged. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

A box around what is scrolled, as wide as what it holds. Not needed to measure: the viewport's children are watched as they are. For content whose own box does not grow with what is in it (a block holding a wider table, or bare text).

Its place and length are written on it inline, and a design does not set these: `position: relative`, `inset-inline-start` and `width`, with `height: inherit` (on a vertical slider, `position: absolute`, `bottom` and `height`, with `width: inherit`).

### Slider.Thumb

What is dragged, and what the keyboard moves: a slider to assistive technology. Its place on the track is written on it inline, and a design does not set these: `position: absolute`, `inset-inline-start` at its value's place and `top: 50%` (on a vertical slider, `bottom` and `left: 50%`), and a `translate` that centres it there (with `thumbAlignment: "edge"`, one that keeps it inside). The track needs `position: relative`. It holds a hidden input, which a form reads. A thumb that is given no `index` is the value at its place among the slider's thumbs, in the order they are written.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-orientation` (horizontal, vertical) | The way the track runs. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |
| `data-readonly` | Present when it can be read but not changed. |
| `data-dragging` | Present while a pointer holds a thumb. |
| `data-touched` | Inside a Field: present once focus has left the control. |
| `data-dirty` | Inside a Field: present while the value is not the one it started with. |
| `data-filled` | Inside a Field: present while the control has a value. |
| `data-focused` | Inside a Field: present while the control has focus. |
| `data-valid` | Inside a Field: present once the value has been checked and found right. |
| `data-invalid` | Inside a Field: present while the value is wrong. |
| `data-index` | Which thumb it is, from 0. |

| Variable | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `--position` | With thumbs that stay inside the control: where the thumb's centre is. |

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-hidden` | Present while its tab is not the active one. |
| `data-index` | The panel's place among the panels in the page, from 0, once it is in the page. |
| `data-orientation` (horizontal, vertical) | The way the tabs are laid out. |
| `data-activation-direction` (left, right, up, down, none) | Where the newly active tab is from the one before, for a panel or a mark that slides. |
| `data-starting-style` | Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from. |
| `data-ending-style` | Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends. |

## Toggle

### Toggle.Root

The button. It stays pressed until it is pressed again.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-pressed` | Present while it is pressed. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

## ToggleGroup

### ToggleGroup.Root

The group. A toggle inside it with a `value` is one of its toggles.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-orientation` (horizontal, vertical) | Whether its toggles are in a row or a column. |
| `data-multiple` | Present when several can be pressed at a time. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

## Toolbar

```
Root
  Group (optional, repeated)
    Button (repeated)
    Link (repeated)
    Input (repeated)
  Separator (repeated)
```

### Toolbar.Root

The toolbar. It is one stop for Tab.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-orientation` (horizontal, vertical) | Whether the toolbar is a row or a column. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

### Toolbar.Button

A button of the toolbar.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-orientation` (horizontal, vertical) | Whether the toolbar is a row or a column. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |
| `data-focusable` | Present when it stays focusable while disabled: the arrows still reach it. |

### Toolbar.Link

A link of the toolbar.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-orientation` (horizontal, vertical) | Whether the toolbar is a row or a column. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

### Toolbar.Input

A text input of the toolbar. The arrows are its own until the caret is at an end.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-orientation` (horizontal, vertical) | Whether the toolbar is a row or a column. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |
| `data-focusable` | Present when it stays focusable while disabled: the arrows still reach it. |

### Toolbar.Group

Items that belong together.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-orientation` (horizontal, vertical) | Whether the toolbar is a row or a column. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

### Toolbar.Separator

A line between items, across the toolbar.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-orientation` (horizontal, vertical) | Whether the toolbar is a row or a column. |

## Tooltip

```
Root
  Trigger
  Portal
    Positioner
      Popup
        Arrow
```

### Tooltip.Root

Holds the tooltip: whether it is open. It draws no element.

### Tooltip.Trigger

The element the tooltip describes.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-popup-open` | Present when the tooltip is open. |
| `data-trigger-disabled` | Present when the tooltip is disabled: the pointer and focus on the trigger do not open it. |

### Tooltip.Portal

Draws what it holds at the end of `<body>`, or in the container a `PortalProvider` names. It draws no element.

### Tooltip.Positioner

Places the popup against the trigger. It carries the geometry.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-side` (top, right, bottom, left, inline-start, inline-end) | The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor. |
| `data-align` (start, center, end) | How it is aligned with the anchor. |
| `data-anchor-hidden` | Present while the anchor is out of view: scrolled away, or clipped by a box around it. |

| Variable | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `--anchor-width` | The anchor's width. |
| `--anchor-height` | The anchor's height. |
| `--available-width` | The width between the anchor and the edge of the viewport. |
| `--available-height` | The height between the anchor and the edge of the viewport. |
| `--transform-origin` | The point of the popup nearest its anchor, to scale from. |
| `--positioner-width` | The popup's width, as its content lays it out: a design gives the positioner `width: var(--positioner-width)` to animate a change of size. |
| `--positioner-height` | The popup's height, as its content lays it out: a design gives the positioner `height: var(--positioner-height)` to animate a change of size. |

### Tooltip.Popup

The tooltip itself.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-starting-style` | Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from. |
| `data-ending-style` | Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends. |
| `data-side` (top, right, bottom, left, inline-start, inline-end) | The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor. |
| `data-align` (start, center, end) | How it is aligned with the anchor. |
| `data-instant` (delay, focus, dismiss) | Present when it opened or closed without its usual wait, for a design that skips the motion then. |

### Tooltip.Arrow

An element that points at the trigger, placed along the popup's edge.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-side` (top, right, bottom, left, inline-start, inline-end) | The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor. |
| `data-align` (start, center, end) | How it is aligned with the anchor. |
| `data-instant` (delay, focus, dismiss) | Present when it opened or closed without its usual wait, for a design that skips the motion then. |
| `data-uncentered` | Present when the popup was pushed along its edge, so the arrow is not at the trigger's centre. |
